parts.name: A1 max over arms and cases of abs(u(new) + u(old) - 1), change@0 and change@1
A6 sham cost to the sheet, cue@0: r_all(rest) - r_all(dial)
A6 sham cost to the sheet, none@0: r_all(rest) - r_all(dial)

statements.claim: on the information-limit pair every policy ties, the controller included
statements.rule: HOLDS if, in change@0 and change@1, the largest abs(u(arm, change/new) + u(arm, change/old) - 1) over every arm and case is at most 1e-12, else FAILS (derived identity)

statements.claim: with a perfect signal the controller beats the best fixed policy
statements.rule: HOLDS if U_ctrl(h 1, f 0) - U(BEST) >= 0.04, else FAILS

statements.claim: and with a moderately reliable one
statements.rule: HOLDS if U_ctrl(h 0.75, f 0.25) - U(BEST) >= 0, else FAILS

statements.claim: an uninformative signal buys nothing; discrimination is what pays
statements.rule: HOLDS if U_ctrl(h 0.5, f 0.5) - U(BEST) <= 0.03 and U_ctrl(h 1, f 0) - U_ctrl(h 1, f 1) >= 0.04, else FAILS

statements.claim: copies cannot repair an error they share; the signalled cue can
statements.rule: HOLDS if, in correlated errors, u(dial) - u(record) >= 0.3, u(dial) - u(body) >= 0.1 and u(dial) - u(vote) >= 0.1, else FAILS

statements.claim: a false alarm costs the sheet little
statements.rule: HOLDS if r_all(rest) - r_all(dial) is at most 0.01 under scattered cue damage and at most 0.002 with no event (a derived bound; BE002's floor), else FAILS

statements.claim: a cue latch held for the calibrated commitment turns scattered cue corruption into lasting false re-specification
statements.rule: HOLDS if, under scattered cue damage, r_all(arbiter) - r_all(latch) >= 0.1, else FAILS

statements.claim: which source to trust depends on the situation
statements.rule: HOLDS if u(record, none) - u(body, none) >= 0.02 and u(body, memory) - u(record, memory) >= 0.2, else FAILS

statements.claim: the evidence clock bounds the controller
statements.rule: HOLDS if, in memory damage, u(dial-m2) - u(dial) <= 0 and u(dial-m0.5) - u(dial) >= -0.02, else FAILS

statements.claim: the signal must be where the damage is
statements.rule: HOLDS if, in memory damage, u(dial-s6) - u(rest) <= 0.05 and u(dial-s4) - u(dial) <= -0.15, and under scattered cue damage sham(dial-d8) - sham(dial) >= 0.02, else FAILS
HOLDS if, at GC001's sigma 1 against sigma 0, the differences in u(dial, change/new) and in u(dial, none) are each <= 0, else FAILS
